song: 64 - Megan Thee Stallion - Cash Shit ft. Da Baby
title: the sand pours on the 808
story: Cash Shit is a half-time trap groove at about 129 bpm, with the 808 on the big low hits and a snare on each half-time backbeat. The build keeps the glass brightening and the stream widening through the pre-roll, with the five huge 808 hits (4, 70, 211, 329, 344) each pouring a single avalanche of sand. The drop at 477 shakes the box hard, flashes the frame and steps the matiz, then the picture settles into the steady post-roll where the sides of the pour swap every two bars.
